scope: CPU-only independent raw trajectory recomputation and saved dev record classification; no simulation, training or qualification

method.raw_rotation_math: NumPy float64 xyzw quaternion formulas; no product conversion helper
method.dwell: Consecutive true samples counted independently; ceil(stable_dwell_s/dt). Recovery samples strictly after injection and through inclusive ceil(window) endpoint.
method.angular_motion: world angular velocity norm; unwrapped quaternion yaw change/path from first captured physics sample to last. World z integral is recorded separately.
method.full_raw_coverage: For B: first public_dev seed strong_push 2x64; matched no_push 2x64. Remaining dev seeds have saved per_episode evidence but no complete raw trajectories.
method.comparison_to_original: Original checkpoint is a paired comparator, not expected to reproduce new outcomes. B strong_push raw capture must reproduce B first dev seed exactly.

engineering_requires: Actual training complete at 500 iterations with finite evidence
paired claim requires initial policy hash equal to original seed42
only public_dev executed; original holdouts untouched
interpretation: Report paired raw dev rates against original reference; one training seed is not replication
Go2 dev saturation is a task-calibration issue; do not relax headroom threshold
G1 below basic floor or standing readiness stops this hypothesis; no coefficient retries
No default reference promotion or Genesis from this study
New formal qualification needs separately frozen fresh unconsumed accept/sealed

no_push_followup.definition: fraction of no-push first episodes having at least one full continuous stable dwell

limitations: One training seed, dev-only study. Not qualified reference; no Genesis or promotion.
Saved per_episode facts allow classification and event integrity checks for all 384 dev episodes; full independent dwell reconstruction only for the first dev seed per robot.
Checkpoint binaries are not locally downloaded; identity relies on preserved execution load/hash receipts, not a new local checkpoint byte read.
Instantaneous reward or this result cannot prove absence of deliberate-fall incentives over discounted episode returns.
conclusion: Both robots meet the frozen B development criteria; no formal qualification inferred. Current dev rate exceeds the unchanged 0.9 headroom ceiling, so B is not a qualified reference.
